title: Marcos heads to China for APEC, sets sights on investments
summary: A few hours after hosting US President Donald Trump at the Palace, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. departed for Shenzhen, China on Wednesday for the 33rd Economic Leaders' Meeting.
